definitions.label: Asset poverty
definitions.value: Household net worth is below the amount needed to cover three months at the poverty threshold without income.
definitions.note: Net worth includes durable wealth such as a home or business, which may need to be sold. This measure differs from annual income poverty.

definitions.label: Liquid asset poverty
definitions.value: Household liquid assets are below the amount needed to cover three months at the poverty threshold without income.
definitions.note: The provider includes cash, bank accounts, stocks, mutual funds and specified retirement accounts; excludes equity in businesses, vehicles, homes and other real estate.

definitions.label: Household-size benchmark
definitions.value: The benchmark depends on household size and the threshold period used by the source.
definitions.note: The current explanatory copy gives a four-person 2020 example of USD 6,550. That example is retained as context and is not relabelled as a 2021 threshold.

definitions.label: Source periods and precision
definitions.value: Current Ohio and US values are labelled 2021 by the Scorecard; historical trend fields carry their own year labels.
definitions.note: The state source is labelled Survey of Income and Program Participation. Missing/suppressed trend values use -1. Provider fields ending _moe are retained literally without an inferred confidence level or unit.

notes: Definition text here is an original paraphrase of the provider's retained original copy. Statistical API responses remain unchanged.
The original assessed-tab links labelled SIPP point to an ACS URL. Source labels are retained; no replacement microdata analysis is claimed.
The provider's 2021 and 2019 _moe fields are 10 for both Ohio and US. Their unchanged values are available as source fields, without manufacturing a confidence interval.
The issuer's 2011 table values predate the returned API trend fields; they are retained only in the transcription concordance.
